cues.caption: Welcome back, champ!
cues.text: Hey champ, welcome back! I'm so excited about today.

cues.caption: Unit 1 · What Is AI? · done!
cues.text: You finished all of Unit one! You learned what AI is, and you met AI helpers that translate, find the way, and show captions. Give yourself a big pat on the back!

cues.caption: Unit 2 · How Machines Learn
cues.text: Today, we're starting Unit two. It's called, How Machines Learn.

cues.caption: Chapter 1 · Teaching a Computer Like a Puppy
cues.text: And chapter one has a funny name. Teaching a computer, like teaching a puppy!

cues.caption: A puppy and a computer? Let's find out!
cues.text: A puppy, and a computer? What could they possibly have in common? Let's find out.

cues.caption: Meet Kabir and his puppy, Laddoo!
cues.text: Meet Kabir. And this is his brand new puppy. Her name is Laddoo, because she's round, and golden, and sweet!

cues.caption: Kabir says it once: "Sit!"
cues.text: Kabir wants to teach Laddoo to sit. So he says it once, nice and loud. Sit!

cues.caption: Laddoo just chases her tail!
cues.text: And Laddoo wags her tail, and chases it, round and round and round. Not sitting at all!

cues.caption: Why didn't Laddoo learn? Think!
cues.text: Why didn't Laddoo learn? Kabir did tell her, didn't he? Think about it.

cues.caption: Puppies need many tries, not just one
cues.text: Here's the thing. A puppy doesn't learn from just one try. She needs to be shown, again and again.

cues.caption: 1 · Show: gently help her sit
cues.text: So Kabir tries a smarter way. He says sit, and gently helps Laddoo sit down. That shows her what sit means.

cues.caption: 2 · Praise: "Good dog!" and a treat
cues.text: The moment she sits, Kabir says, good dog! And gives her a treat. Yum! Now Laddoo knows, that was right.

cues.caption: 3 · Practise: many tries, then she's got it!
cues.text: Then they practise. Again tomorrow, and the day after that. Many, many tries. And one day, Kabir says sit, and Laddoo sits, every single time!

cues.caption: We teach a computer in a similar way!
cues.text: Now, here's the cool part. We teach a computer in a very similar way!

cues.caption: Show the AI lots and lots of cat photos
cues.text: Say we want an AI to know what a cat looks like. We don't just tell it once. We show it lots and lots of cat photos.

cues.caption: Right? Say yes! Wrong? Say no.
cues.text: Then it starts guessing. When it's right, we tell it, yes! When it's wrong, we tell it, no. Just like Kabir saying, good dog.

cues.caption: More practice → better guesses. Not magic!
cues.text: And with more practice, its guesses get better and better. It isn't magic, and it isn't alive. It's finding patterns, in the examples we show it.

cues.caption: Photo + name sticker = a labelled example
cues.text: Each cat photo has its name stuck on it, like a little sticker that says, cat. That's called a labelled example.

cues.caption: Lots of labelled examples = TRAINING
cues.text: And showing an AI lots and lots of labelled examples has a special name. It's called, training.

cues.caption: Not a train ride! Teaching with examples.
cues.text: No, not a train ride! Choo choo! Training just means teaching, with lots of examples.

cues.caption: You be the teacher! Say yes or no.
cues.text: Let's play. You be the teacher! The AI will guess, and you say yes, or no.

cues.caption: The AI says "cat" both times. Yes or no?
cues.text: Here's a stripy cat. The AI says, cat. And here's a dog. The AI says, cat. What do you tell it each time? Pause, and think.

cues.caption: Cat: yes! Dog: no! That helps it learn.
cues.text: Stripy cat? Yes, well done! The dog? No, try again! Your yes and no help the AI learn, just like praise helps Laddoo.

cues.caption: Train with just ONE orange cat photo
cues.text: Now, how many photos should we show? Let's try just one. One photo of an orange cat, labelled cat.

cues.caption: Black cat? The AI says "not a cat"! Why?
cues.text: Then we show it a black cat. And the AI says, not a cat! Oh no. What went wrong? Think.

cues.caption: It thinks all cats are orange! One isn't enough
cues.text: With only one photo, the AI thought orange was part of being a cat! So it thinks all cats are orange. One example is never enough.

cues.caption: Black · White · Stripy · Big · Tiny
cues.text: But real cats come in so many kinds. Black, white, stripy, big, and tiny!

cues.caption: Many cats → it learns what all cats share
cues.text: When the AI sees lots of different cats, it learns what all cats share. Pointy ears, whiskers, and a long tail. Now it can spot a cat it has never seen before!

cues.caption: Which set teaches "cat" best?
cues.text: Quick quiz! Which set teaches cat best? One orange cat. Five photos of the same cat. A hundred dog photos. Or a hundred photos of many different cats? Pause, and pick.

cues.caption: 100 different cats wins!
cues.text: A hundred photos of many different cats! Lots of examples, and lots of kinds. And the dog photos won't teach cat at all!

cues.caption: Step 1 · TRAIN: lots of labelled examples
cues.text: So, how do we know if the AI really learned? We do two steps. Step one, train. Show it lots of labelled examples.

cues.caption: Step 2 · TEST: a new photo, see its guess
cues.text: Step two, test. Give it a brand new photo, one it has never seen, with no label. And see what it guesses.

cues.caption: Wrong? Train with more, then test again
cues.text: Wrong guess? No problem. Show it more examples, and test again. First train, then test. Just like Laddoo. If she forgets, Kabir practises with her some more.

cues.caption: Your turn: practice check
cues.text: Okay champ, it's practice check time, just like the quiz.

cues.caption: Teach "bus": 1 photo or 100? Why?
cues.text: Kabir wants to teach an AI what a bus is. Should he show one photo, or a hundred? And why? Pause the video, and try it on paper.

cues.caption: 100! Many kinds → it learns what buses share
cues.text: A hundred photos! Buses come in many colours and sizes. Red city buses, yellow school buses, even double-deckers. With lots of labelled bus photos, the AI learns what all buses share. Not just one bus. Super thinking!

cues.caption: Training = showing lots of examples
cues.text: Let's remember. Training means showing lots of examples.

cues.caption: Labelled examples have their names on
cues.text: Labelled examples have their names stuck on them.

cues.caption: One example is not enough
cues.text: One example is not enough. Remember the orange cat?

cues.caption: First train, then test
cues.text: And first we train, then we test.

cues.caption: Chapter 1 done!
cues.text: Chapter one of Unit two, done! You just learned how computers learn, champ. Laddoo is very proud of you!

cues.caption: Next: Quiz · Tap Finish
cues.text: Now let's see what you remember. Tap Finish, and try the quiz. You've got this!
